questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Doughty”, meaning: Brave, courageous, and determined, especially in the face of difficulty or danger.
answer: The doughty commander refused to retreat even when his forces were heavily outnumbered.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Sibyls”, meaning: Women believed to possess prophetic powers; female prophets or seers.
answer: The sibyls warned that arrogance would bring about the kingdom's downfall.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Erstwhile”, meaning: Former; belonging to an earlier time.
answer: The erstwhile rivals set aside their differences to confront a common threat.

questions.question:
Imagine you have a friend whom you trust, who then goes and betrays you. How would it have felt?
Word Limit — 150-200
answer:
In Grade 7, Arjun was the one person I told everything to. So when I finally admitted that I was terrified of the school swimming test because I had never learned to swim, I told only him. He promised he would keep it to himself.
The next morning, I walked into class, and three boys started flapping their arms and pretending to drown. Arjun was laughing with them. He didn’t look at me once.
What hurt was not the joke. Jokes end. What hurt was realising that every secret I had ever given him was now in someone else’s hands. I kept replaying our conversations, wondering which ones he had already shared. I felt foolish, as if I had been talking to a stranger wearing my friend’s face.
For weeks, I didn’t trust anyone with anything, not even small things like which film I liked. Slowly, that wall came down, but I still choose more carefully now. Betrayal didn’t just cost me a friend. For a while, it cost me my trust in everyone.
